layer: derived (separate from raw feed; raw positions untouched)
sample_time_rule: sample[i] = meta.range_utc[0] + i days; actual time of day preserved; date keys are labels, not midnight

speed_provenance.units: deg/day, apparent geocentric ecliptic of date (from raw ecl_lon_deg)
speed_provenance.authority: derived; never overrides a newer valid daily longitude_speed

station_rules.refinement: least-squares quadratic vertex of unwrapped longitude over +/- half_window_days around the sign change
station_rules.half_window_provenance: SPEC §4.6 (luminous_gate_reconstruction.json aspects_orbs.stations.half_window_days); default 7 for non-SPEC bodies is a documented conservative parameter

stations.timestamp_precision: about +/- 0.5 day for slow bodies (flat motion near station); daily sampling
stations.derivation_method: sign change of six_month_central_difference speed; refined by least_squares_quadratic_vertex
